business_problem: Liepin wanted to connect large-model capabilities to real recruiting workflows in a way that improved both quality and economics, because early model adoption brought opportunity but not enough business return without better model performance and tighter alignment with recruiting use cases.
solution_summary: Liepin integrated Baidu AI Cloud's large-model capabilities into Doris, its intelligent interview product, to automate talent evaluation across hiring, probation assessment, talent review, and role transfer or promotion scenarios. Rather than treating AI as a generic chatbot, the implementation used large-model reasoning to structure multi-dimensional candidate evaluation against more than 100 dimensions aligned to the seven layers of the iceberg competency model. The platform also strengthened fraud prevention with all-round anti-cheating checks and delivered a four-step setup path so enterprise customers could create customized intelligent interviews quickly. At runtime, Doris supports realistic interview experiences across multiple client types and languages, then generates structured reports for employers. The result is a recruiting-evaluation workflow where AI handles screening consistency, report depth, and interview delivery at a scale and cost profile that would be difficult to reproduce with traditional expert interviewers alone.

solution_components.name: Doris
solution_components.role: Runs intelligent interviews, evaluates candidates across multi-dimensional competency models, and returns structured reports for recruiting and talent-management decisions.

data_flow: Recruiting teams configure an interview in a few steps, candidates complete the AI interview across supported devices and languages, Doris scores the interaction across more than 100 dimensions with anti-cheating checks, and structured reports flow back into hiring and talent-review workflows.
business_outcome: Liepin gave employers a faster, cheaper, and more consistent interview workflow, while improving anti-cheat controls and delivering structured insight that supports broader talent-management decisions.
